driverFormulas.rev: Total Revenue = Gross Sales − GTN Deductions
driverFormulas.cogs: Cost of Sales = API + Manufacturing Conversion + Packaging, QC & Royalties
driverFormulas.gp: Gross Profit = Total Revenue − Cost of Sales
driverFormulas.gp-pct: Gross Margin % = GP / Total Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.opex-excl: Operating Expenses (excl. D&A) = Selling, Marketing & Distribution + R&D + G&A
driverFormulas.ebitda-pct: EBITDA Margin % = EBITDA / Total Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.da: Depreciation, Amortisation & Impairment = Product Intangibles + Sites + IT & Software
driverFormulas.ebit-pct: Operating Margin % = Operating Profit / Total Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.nonop: Net Finance Expense = Interest Income − Interest Expense + Other Financial
driverFormulas.ebt: Profit Before Tax = Operating Profit + Net Finance Expense
driverFormulas.ni: Profit After Tax = Profit Before Tax − Taxation
driverFormulas.ni-pct: Net Margin % = PAT / Total Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.bs-assets: Total Assets = Current Assets + Non-Current Assets
driverFormulas.bs-ca: Current Assets = Cash + Receivables + Inventories + Prepaids
driverFormulas.bs-inv: Inventories = API + Drug Substance (WIP) + Finished Goods
driverFormulas.bs-nca: Non-Current Assets = PP&E + Accum. Depreciation + Intangibles & Goodwill + Other
driverFormulas.bs-liab-eq: Total Liabilities & Equity = Current Liabilities + Non-Current Liabilities + Equity
driverFormulas.bs-cl: Current Liabilities = Payables + Accruals + ST Debt + GTN Accruals
driverFormulas.bs-ncl: Non-Current Liabilities = LT Debt + Deferred Tax + Other
driverFormulas.bs-equity: Equity = Share Capital + Retained Earnings + OCI
driverFormulas.cfo: Net Cash Inflow from Operating Activities = PAT + D&A + Working Capital
driverFormulas.cfi: Net Cash Outflow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions / Licensing
driverFormulas.cff: Net Cash Outflow from Financing Activities = Debt + Share Buyback + Dividends
driverFormulas.cf-net: Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
driverFormulas.cf-end-cash: Closing Cash = Net Change + Opening Cash
driverFormulas.cogs-pct: This KPI provides a direct measure of manufacturing efficiency and cost structure, complementing the existing Gross Margin % (gp-pct) by showing the cost side explicitly. It enables management to track cost inflation, manufacturing productivity, and pricing power trends.
